job.rawJd: The Infosys Engineering unit focuses on product-centric value delivery through data-first engineering, value-stream management, AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics. The Architecture Consultant 3 creates business requirement documents from stakeholder workshops and interviews; reviews, proposes, and develops scalable, reliable, and maintainable solution architectures; recommends technologies, tools, and platforms; develops integration strategies; resolves complex technical challenges during build, deployment, and support; advises development teams and clients; identifies system risks and performance improvements; maintains a knowledge base; and contributes architectural input to proposals and RFPs. Required skills include end-to-end AI solution architecture, prompt engineering, and knowledge-retrieval architecture using vector databases and semantic search. Preferred experience includes architecture governance and reviews; cloud and platform engineering; data and integration architecture; AI-driven software engineering; executive stakeholder management; value-stream discovery workshops; AI strategy and roadmap definition; and pre-sales and solutioning. A bachelor's degree or an experience-based equivalent is required. Travel or relocation may be required. Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States without current or future employer-based sponsorship.
